sion{text-align:center;padding:8px 0}.location-permission .pin-big{font-size:58px}.location-permission p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.location-permission .privacy-note{background:#f6f9fb;border:1px solid #e5edf3;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#6a7d91;text-align:right;margin:14px 0}.location-permission .location-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.secondary-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid #cbd9e4;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800}.location-link-preview{display:block;direction:ltr;text-align:left;background:#f8fbfd;border:1px solid #e5edf3;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:10px;color:#55708d;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;margin:9px 0}
.form-location-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 12px;background:#f7fafc;border:1px solid #e0e9ef;border-radius:13px;margin:2px 0 5px}.form-location-card.saved{background:#effaf5;border-color:#c8eadc}.form-location-icon{font-size:21px}.form-location-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}.form-location-copy strong{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--navy)}.form-location-copy small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.form-location-card.saved .form-location-copy strong{color:#08784f}.form-location-btn{background:#fff;border:1px solid #cfe0e9;color:var(--navy);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:9px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.form-grid .field-hint{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:-8px}.address-optional{font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy),#123e79)}
footer{border-top:1px solid #edf2f5}.footer-brand .brand-logo{width:78px;height:78px;flex-basis:78px}.footer-brand .brand-text b{font-size:20px}.footer-brand .brand-text small{font-size:12px}

/* v6.6 operations, tracking, cart & trust */
.cart-nav-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid #d7e4ec;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.cart-nav-btn b,.floating-cart b{min-width:21px;height:21px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px}
.floating-cart{display:none;position:fixed;left:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:35;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:11px 14px;box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(11,45,99,.25);font-weight:800;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.floating-cart b{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.trust-center{padding-top:50px;padding-bottom:50px;background:#fff}
.trust-center-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}
.trust-center-card{border:1px solid #e4edf2;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;background:#fbfdff}
.trust-center-card span{font-size:27px}.trust-center-card strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);margin:8px 0 3px}.trust-center-card p{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.footer-action{background:none;border:0;padding:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:7px 0;display:block;text-align:right;cursor:pointer}
.success-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f5fcf9,#fff);border:1px solid #d9eee5;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;margin-top:12px}
.success-order-id{font-size:22px;color:var(--navy);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.4px;direction:ltr}
.success-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#e9f8f2;color:#08784f;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin:8px 0}
.success-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}.success-actions .primary-btn,.success-actions .secondary-btn,.success-actions a{text-decoration:none;text-align:center}
.track-form{display:grid;gap:11px}.track-form input{width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #d9e3eb;border-radius:11px;outline:none}
.track-result{margin-top:16px}.track-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:#f5f9fc;border:1px solid #e3ecf2;border-radius:14px;padding:12px}
.track-head strong{color:var(--navy)}.track-head small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}
.track-steps{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:13px}.track-step{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;color:#8a99aa;font-size:12px}
.track-step i{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#edf2f5;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.track-step.done{color:#08784f;font-weight:800}.track-step.done i{background:#dff5eb;color:#08784f}.track-step.current{color:var(--navy);font-weight:900}.track-step.current i{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cancelled-box{padding:14px;border-radius:13px;background:#fff1f1;color:#a43b3b;font-weight:800;margin-top:12px}
.policy-box{color:#405a74;font-size:13px}.policy-box h3{color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:4px}.policy-box p{margin-top:4px}.policy-box ul{padding-right:20px}
.cart-persist-note{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px}
@media(max-width:1050px){.cart-nav-btn{display:none}}
@media(max-width:900px){.floating-cart{display:flex}.trust-center-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.trust-center-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.success-actions{grid-template-columns:1fr}.floating-cart{left:12px;bottom:12px}}
.service-card .icon.consult-trio{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-2px;white-space:nowrap}
.hero-logo-badge{position:absolute;left:22px;top:22px;width:82px;height:82px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5edf3;border-radius:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(11,45,99,.10);z-index:3}.hero-logo-badge img{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:contain;display:block}@media(max-width:560px){.brand{min-width:auto;gap:8px}.brand-logo{width:46px;height:46px;flex-basis:46px}.brand-text b{font-size:15px}.brand-text small{font-size:9px}.footer-brand .brand-logo{width:64px;height:64px;flex-basis:64px}}
